leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Implement a soft delete mechanism by updating the database schema with a 'deletedAt' timestamp field
Configure API endpoints to handle soft delete requests without permanently removing records
Construct restore endpoints that reinstate soft-deleted records by clearing the 'deletedAt' field
Apply conditional query logic to exclude soft-deleted records from standard GET requests
Integrate middleware to validate user permissions before processing soft delete or restore operations
Manipulate database queries to include soft-deleted records only when explicitly requested
Initialize and test both soft delete and restore endpoints using API testing tools
lessonTitle: Build soft delete and restore endpoints
